# Intellumia

> Intellumia, the AI partner for owner-run businesses.

Intellumia shows owner-run businesses where AI makes them money, runs the parts that do with named professionals signing off, and takes no vendor fees.

Where will AI make your business money? We will show you, then run it. In two to three weeks, starting from summaries of your own books, we show you the two or three places AI would make your business the most money, and what each is worth. Then we run the ones you choose.

We price each move in your own numbers, name at least one way to do it that is not us, and take no fees from vendors. Where we run the work, a named professional signs off.

## Who we work with

For owner-run companies across India, where the owner decides and signs the cheque. Where we start:

- Construction, EPC and roads
- Specialty and agro chemicals
- Auto components
- Pharma and APIs
- Hospitals and healthcare chains

## Where it starts

We start with your money. AI is how we do it.

Illustration, not a client: where money usually leaks in an owner-run business, drawn as five rooms with money dripping from each into a tray marked money lost every month. Your Map finds your leaks, puts a rupee figure on each, and names the one to plug first. In the illustration, finance is the first move and plant and operations the next move.

- Plant and operations. Costs are up and you cannot pass them on. Your costliest process, done a better way, tested on your own past records before anyone changes how they work.
- Finance. Customers owe you more than they should. What is owed to you across your companies, sorted, and a steady routine to bring it in.
- MIS and reporting. You find out late, from numbers built by hand. One page across every company you own.
- IT and vendors. Your staff already use AI tools, and vendors want renewals. AI in your business, listed and under your control.
- Owner's office. A handover, a new chief executive, a sale or a listing. The decisions only you make, written down and tested.

## How it works

A Map first. Then we run the parts that pay.

- Map (start here): A review across the whole business, two to three weeks, for a fee agreed up front. Always paid, and the fee never depends on what you buy next.
- Run (if you choose): AI agents do the work, named professionals sign off, and you see the result every week. We connect, test on your past records, run in shadow beside your people, and switch on only with your sign-off, within 90 days.
- Guide (alongside): Independent advice on your side, on AI, vendors and the board, with no fees from vendors. Covers AI policy and oversight, vendor choice and renewals, readiness for India's data protection duties, and a quarterly review of your Map.

## The Map

Two to three weeks. Your numbers. Your choice.

What the Map gives you:

- A one-page map of the money in your business.
- Two or three priced moves, with one named first move.
- A baseline for each move, measured on your own data.
- One working proof on your data for the first move.
- At least two ways to do each move, one of them not Intellumia.

Your time: about 20 to 40 hours of your staff across the two to three weeks. We agree it with you before we start.

How the weeks run:

- Start: Kick-off. We ask for summaries only, never all your books on day one.
- Week 1: Interviews with you and four to six heads of function. We find out what systems and data you have.
- Week 2: We value each move and test the top ones on your past records.
- Week 3: The readout, to you alone.

## Our rules

On your side of the table, in writing.

1. Every move is valued in your numbers before you spend anything.
2. You choose each move, in writing, from at least two ways to do it.
3. We take no fees from vendors. No referral fees, no resale margins.
4. Where we run the work, a named professional signs off.
5. Your data stays in your environment, with models that neither keep nor train on it.
6. Your data, your configuration and your running instance are yours, with the right to run it without us.
